reevaluation: Not a finding, and re-verification does not change that. The review's verdict was test-defect: the scenario asserts both that version=signed on a PENDING envelope returns a PDF (step 7) and that it does not (step 8), so one step fails by construction, and the product did what both bound doc pages say it does. Today the download handlers are untouched since the tested tag and both doc sentences are still in place, so there is nothing to report and nothing to re-evaluate. The right action remains a corpus-side conflict resolution in favour of common-workflows.mdx, not an upstream filing. The one genuine observation in the review, that Content-Disposition still names the unsigned original <title>_signed.pdf, is a minor naming wart the docs already warn about and is not worth an issue on its own.
notes: If anyone later wants to file the filename note, it belongs as a comment on existing issue #3096, which is already about the Content-Disposition filename built by the same handler, not as a new issue.
